Departments
Departments
Administration
The Administrator is the Chief Administrative Officer of the County and is responsible to the Board of County Commissioners for the effective administration of all governmental affairs of the County, which legally may be placed in his/her charge.
Appraiser
The function of the County Appraiser is to develop a listing of all personal and real properties for taxation purposes.
Attorney
The County Attorney's office handles felony crimes, drug crimes, domestic batteries, misdemeanors, and traffic prosecutions.
Building Maintenance
The Building Maintenance Department provides management and maintenance of over 30 County owned / leased buildings and facilities.
Clerk
The position of the County Clerk is an elected position with a term of four years and is Secretary to the Board of County Commissioners.
Department of Corrections
Election Office
The Finney County Election Office is a function of the Finney County Clerk's Office. The Clerk is also the Election Officer. In this office is where you can register to vote, file to run for an elected office, change party affiliation, and stay up to date with important election dates and statute information.
Emergency Management and Safety
Emergency Management is responsible for the development and implementation of a comprehensive emergency program for Finney County.
Emergency Medical Services (EMS)
Incidents as varied as automobile accidents, heart attacks, drowning, childbirth, and gunshot wounds all require immediate medical attention.
Fairgrounds
Schedule your next event with us and utilize our versatile facilities!
Geographic Information Systems (GIS)
Health Department
No appointment is necessary at our Nursing Clinic for immunizations, refill of contraceptive methods, or most of the available services.
Human Resources
Human Resources is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining uniform employee recruitment procedures in compliance with applicable State and Federal laws.
Information Technology (IT)
Office of Information Technology for Finney County
Planning and Development
The Division of Planning and Development guides responsible growth and development throughout the unincorporated area of Finney County by carrying out the goals of the Comprehensive Plans and enforcing local zoning and subdivision regulations.
Public Works
Public Works is responsible for the County’s infrastructure consisting of over 1,225 miles of roadway stretching across 1,302 square miles of land.
Register of Deeds
The Register of Deeds office files and records documents that pertain to real estate.
Sheriff's Office
Link to the Sheriffs Website

Real Estate Taxes, Personal Property Taxes and Motor Vehicle Tag Renewal taxes and fees are all paid at the Treasurer's Office.

1/2-Cent Sales Tax
On August 4, 2025, the Finney County Commission voted unanimously to place the Finney County Law Enforcement Center renovation and Jail construction dedicated 1/2-cent sales tax on the November 4, 2025, ballot.

Substance Abuse & Addiction Recovery in Garden City, Kansas
Community Calendar
Here you'll find a community calendar full of upcoming events.
Compass Behavioral Health
Compass Behavioral Health provides quality and professional services to help people achieve optimal social and emotional well being.
Convention and Visitors Bureau
Find local attractions, things to do, calendar of events, places to stay, restaurants, hotels, and much more, all in Finney County!
Economic Development
The Finney County Economic Development Corporation was created for and is committed to the continual improvement of the economic quality of life in the Finney County area.
Fair Board
Find information on the annual Finney County Fair, hosted by the Fair Board.
Genesis Family Health
Genesis Family Health (GFH) has provided medical and social programs to thousands of people in Southwest Kansas. A non profit service agency, GFH serves people of all races, colors and faiths. GFH is supported through state and federal grants, as well as the generous donations of local churches, organizations and citizens.
Historical Museum
The Finney County Museum features permanent and revolving exhibits, community programs, educational tours, and extensive research facilities.
KSU Research and Extension
K-State Research and Extension is committed to expanding human capacity by delivering educational programs and technical information that result in improved leadership skills in the areas of communication, group dynamics, conflict resolution, issue analysis, and strategic planning that can enhance the economic viability and quality of life in communities.
Library
The Finney County Library has over 124,000 items, programming for all ages, and a certified Nature Explore site. The Library continuously strives to be a relevant source of services, education, and recreation for our community.
Local Emergency Planning Committee (LEPC)
The Local Emergency Planning Committee (LEPC) exists to develop resilient communities. Each county in Kansas is required to have a Local Emergency Planning Committee (LEPC), comprised of emergency response agencies, hospitals, industries, and community groups.
Planning & Community Development
The Planning Commission makes recommendations on applications for annexation, rezoning, and subdivisions to ensure the orderly growth and anticipated physical development of Finney County and its municipalities.
Public Transportation
City-Link offers transportation to 65 stops around Garden City. Demand Response provides rides to those who live outside of Garden City limits, in Finney County. The Mini Bus offers door-to-door services to the elderly and/or disabled. Ride with Finney County Transit, where our transportation is your destination.
Russell Child Development Center
Russell Child Development Center is a community based not-for-profit organization. RCDC is the umbrella agency for early childhood programs in 19 Southwest Kansas counties.

Senior Center
The Senior Center of Finney County is
committed to providing services, information,
education, and recreation for seniors, families
and caregivers in Finney County.
Spirit of the Plains - CASA
Court Appointed Special Advocates (CASA) volunteers are everyday citizens appointed by judges to advocate for the safety and well-being of children who have been removed from their homes due to parental abuse and neglect. Spirit of the Plains CASA serves the counties of the 25th Judicial District of Kansas.
